profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary:
I developed my love for computers early in life. When I met my first microcontroller, I was amazed by how interconnected hardware and software are. That fascination in the interaction between the two is still what drives me today. I pursued my computer engineering degree to learn more about how the hardware works while pursuing software and firmware development on the side. 

I have had the opportunity to learn in more than just an academic setting while in college. Through projects with The Underwater Robotics Team and working in several professional environments, I’ve had hands-on experience for the last 6 years. There is nothing that I enjoy more than learning, and I am always looking for chances to gain new skills and perspectives.

positions.title: Computer Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed RAICS, a novel PCB verification machine that has helped bring in over $3 million in contracts.
• Classified one million samples in two days by developing a deep image processing UNet with 99% accuracy.
• Contributed to the development of 10 internal IP Disclosures.
• Designed a custom labeling and training pipeline that has handled 30,000 samples to date.

positions.title: Technical Advisor and Vice President
positions.description:
• Designed a spatial awareness stack with perception, localization, and mapping. Built-in redundancy allowed for one system to fail.
• Coded the firmware for the hardware interface and metrics systems. Allowed autonomous control and fly-by-wire.
• Set up an underwater simulator and remote access to our robot during the pandemic.
• Scheduled, organized, and ran over 30 pool tests. Organized outreach events with the Ohio State Fair and Columbus Science Center.
• Managed project planning, documentation, and finances as member of the team leadership for 3 years.

company.name: The Ohio State Underwater Robotics Team

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Shortened the processing time of a pupil-finding vision algorithm from minutes to seconds while improving accuracy.
•	Personally satisfied a unique client's needs by designing an RFID tracker and .NET UI.
•	Built cross-platform apps, styled responsive webpages, and coded dynamic web-apps.

positions.title: Robotics Consultant
positions.description:
•	Upgraded a trade show robot with new power and control systems.
•	Improved usability by adding network connections, video 2-way feed, and an Xbox controller for ease of driving

positions.title: Electrical Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed and programmed new SD to RS232 converter product to allow the company to use old CNC machines.
•	Created online order system and internal portal that has handled 11,000 orders to date.
•	Cut service time by half by designing and building a wire winding machine to make crank triggers.

honors.title: Eagle Scout
honors.issuer: Issued by Boy Scouts of America · Feb 2017

volunteerExperiences.description: I helped mentor team 4611, teaching students about programming, networking, PCB assembly, and pneumatic systems. Together with a small group of students, we worked to design, assemble, and test a PCB used for motor testing. Returned in 2022 teaching machine learning for vision and auto-targeting.

I volunteered for a large number of eagle scout projects, building sheds, trails, dog houses, and refurbishing old buildings. I also ran my own Eagle Scout project building a handicap ramp for St. Mary's church in Delaware, Ohio.

organizations.name: AUVSI
organizations.description: Attended the XPONENTIAL 2019 conference in Chicago as a representative for RoboSub and RoboNation.

organizations.name: The Underwater Robotics Team
organizations.description: Worked to build an autonomous underwater vehicle. Worked on the electrical, software, and acoustics teams.
